name: Queensland Theatre 35 & Under and student concession
summary: Queensland Theatre gives season ticket discounts to people 35 and under and concession to full-time students.
who: People aged 35 or younger, with photo ID showing birth year.
Full-time students with a copy of their student ID.
how: Email proof of age or student status to sales@queenslandtheatre.com.au.
catches: The page does not list prices; it refers to a price table PDF.

evidence.quote: 35 & Under - discount is available to those aged 35 or younger at time of booking, who can provide a photo
numbers or can provide a copy of their Full Time Student ID*.
